Victoria Jiménez Kasintseva was the defending champion [ 1 ] but chose not to participate, instead competing in the women's singles qualifying event, where she lost in the second round to Kamilla Rakhimova . Angella Okutoyi and Meshkatolzahra Safi became the first girls of their countries to win a junior Grand Slam match, representing Kenya and Iran , respectively. Seeds [ edit ] 0 1 .
